title: Yellowed Velvety Portuguese Oxtail Stew
description: A fermented and velvety stew featuring oxtail, perfect for a sick day, this Portuguese dish is low in fat and full of flavor, with a unique leaf-wrap-steam cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the oxtail pieces with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, brown the oxtail pieces over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the port wine and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the bay leaves to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew in the oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the oxtail is tender.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the collard greens for leaf wrapping by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
After the stew has finished cooking, wrap each piece of oxtail in a blanched collard green leaf and serve.
